name: SITE BURIAL
source:
As a researcher hired recently at the Institute, the days drone on with pointless busywork.

But when a facility-wide emergency is suddenly declared and the Site Burial protocol -- the ultimate killswitch -- is initialized, it becomes all too clear that your chances of survival had just become very, very slim.

Yet through pure dumb luck, you survive, along with a stranger you can't quite seem to place.

...

There's something he's not telling you.

[From [url=https://night-asobu.itch.io/site-burial]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为研究所新近录用的一名研究员，你的每一天都在毫无意义的琐碎杂务中缓慢流逝。

然而，当全设施紧急状态骤然拉响、身为终极自毁开关的“站点掩埋”协议正式启动时，残酷的现实瞬间再清楚不过——你活命的几率已经变得渺茫至极。

可偏偏凭着纯粹的狗屎运，你活了下来；与你一同幸存的，还有一名你一时怎么也想不起在哪儿见过的陌生男子。

……

有些事，他正瞒着你没有说出口。

[摘自[url=https://night-asobu.itch.io/site-burial]itch.io[/url]]
